difficulty_reason: The lemma states that the pullback of an invertible sheaf which is very ample for a morphism remains very ample for the base change of that morphism. The proof unwinds the definition of very ampleness as the existence of an immersion into a projective bundle over the base under which the sheaf is the pullback of the tautological twisting sheaf, uses that the projective bundle and its twisting sheaf are compatible with base change, and concludes because the base change of an immersion is an immersion.
